title: redaction/v1
description: Manifest of removals in a share-profile sub-bundle; present ONLY in share exports (SCH-4). Because verbatim model text lives in content-addressed raw/ blobs referenced BY HASH from chained records, redaction = delete blob files + write this manifest: every chained record hash, every link, and the root remain valid, and the verifier reports 'N referenced blobs absent - all listed in redaction.json' as PASS-with-disclosure (verifiable absence). A missing blob NOT listed here = CORRUPT. Only raw/ files are redactable in V1; verdicts, fills, ledgers, and observations can never be silently dropped. Secrets are never present by construction (SEC-1), so redaction exists only for raw model text.

schema.description: Schema name and major version of this document.

profile.description: The only defined redaction profile in V1: opt-in removal of raw model text.

parent_root.description: chain.root of the unredacted parent bundle - a share bundle always names its parent.

removals.description: Every removed file, with its original content address and reason.

path.description: Bundle-relative path of the removed file. V1 grammar restricts removals to the raw/ store.

sha256.description: Original content hash of the removed bytes; must equal the AgentResponded.raw_sha256 commitment in the chained event.

bytes.description: Original byte length of the removed file.

reason.description: Why removed. Single-member V1 enum: user opted out of sharing verbatim model output.
